name: Protagonist
source:
Choose your name, set your age and select a field of study. It is the start of your second year of college and things are off to a rocky start. Before you do anything else, you’ll have to replace the student ID you lost over the summer. Once you’ve left the Administrator’s office it will be up to you to study, build relationships and survive a unique college experience.

[From [url=https://pridedrawing.itch.io/bound-to-college]official site[/url]]
